text:
maya: Quick UX check — exploring a compact interrupt affordance for the Playground streaming pane. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/playground-interrupt-proto — need quick takes on: 1) 'Stop' vs 'Pause' wording, 2) token counter visibility during stream, 3) tooltip/microcopy for regen. Screenshot attached. dylan: Love the compact direction. Quick question: does 'Stop' cancel the response entirely or just pause it so you can resume? Need consistent semantics with the regen button. tim: Implementation note — 'pause' implies we keep the KV cache and can resume streaming; 'stop' implies terminate the stream and clear partial state. Backend only supports resume for short-lived sessions right now. If we want resume UX, we should go with 'Pause'. zoe: From product POV customers get confused by pause vs stop. Maybe label like 'Pause (resume)' and 'Stop (discard)'? Feels wordy though. ash: Accessibility nit — screen readers need explicit announcements when the token counter updates during streaming. Recommend aria-live="polite" on the counter and role="status" for final result notifications. Example: ```
Tokens: 124
``` maya: Good catch. Also color contrast on the token pill is low (3.2:1). Proposal: bg #1F2937 with text #FFFFFF gives ~4.6:1 which meets AA. I'll update the comp. dylan: :thumbsup: Microcopy thought — instead of 'Stop generation' maybe 'Stop response' or 'Interrupt'. Which reads clearer? zoe: Users we've spoken to find 'Stop' clear. 'Interrupt' is a little technical and ambiguous. tim: Keyboard accessibility: focus should move to the interrupt button when streaming starts so keyboard users can stop quickly. Also add aria-pressed state if we treat it as a toggle. ash: Another a11y detail — if the token counter updates rapidly, debounced announcements are important. Otherwise voiceover gets spammy. Suggest announce at most every 500ms and once on stream end. maya: Agreed on debounce. I'll set the prototype to announce every 500ms and on completion. Updated prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/EXAMPLE/playground-interrupt. dylan: I'll consolidate these decisions in the PR description. One more ask: can we surface a tiny label 'tokens' under the pill for clarity? Makes it discoverable for new users. tim: Fine with that. Quick CSS mock: ``` .token-pill{padding:4px 8px;background:#1F2937;color:#fff;border-radius:9999px;font-size:12px} .token-label{font-size:11px;color:#6B7280;margin-top:2px} ``` zoe: If we settle on the verb 'Stop', update the tooltip to: 'Stop response — discards partial output.' Keeps expectations clear. maya: Will update comps and hand off to eng tomorrow. Thanks all! :sparkles:
